behavior: AC1 — guard-no-gui.bats finishes in under 5 s with setup_suite loaded (baseline 30.9 s)
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && s=$(date +%s%N) && ~/.local/bin/bats tests/guard-no-gui.bats tests/vault-health.bats >/dev/null && [ $(( ($(date +%s%N) - s) / 1000000 )) -lt 5000 ]

behavior: AC2/AC3 — skills-pipeline.bats deploys at most 6 times per run, and a write into a shared setup_file home fails
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && out=$(~/.local/bin/bats tests/skills-pipeline.bats tests/guard-lesson-numbers-unique.bats) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^ok [0-9]+ skills-pipeline deploys at most 6 times per run' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^ok [0-9]+ a write into a shared setup_file home fails'
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && awk '/^  test-windows:/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f && /timeout-minutes:/{print $2; exit}' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -qx 20

behavior: AC5 — the stray detector reports a process in its own run's tmpdir and ignores one in another run's
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && out=$(~/.local/bin/bats tests/guard-no-gui.bats tests/guard-lesson-numbers-unique.bats) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^ok [0-9]+ guard: the stray detector ignores a test-shaped process from another bats run' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^ok [0-9]+ guard: the stray detector matches a test-shaped GUI process'

behavior: AC6 — CI runs the Linux bats suite with --jobs and without parallelizing within files
AC7 — no two workflow jobs share a display name, so exactly one reports `lint`
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && out=$(~/.local/bin/bats tests/workflow-job-names.bats tests/guard-lesson-numbers-unique.bats) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq '^ok [0-9]+ workflow job display names are unique across workflows'

behavior: AC8 — the test-windows doctor-gate step carries GH_TOKEN
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && awk '/name: Post-setup doctor gate/{f=1} f && /name: Run Pester/{exit} f' .github/workflows/ci.yml | grep -q 'GH_TOKEN: \${{ github.token }}'

behavior: AC9 — P1.3 declined, with the layer split and the critical-path measurement recorded
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && v=$(git ls-files -- '*CI-004-testing-surface-optimization/verification.md' | head -1) && [ -n "$v" ] && grep -Eq 'AC9 .*P1\.3 declined' "$v" && grep -q '26.5 s' "$v" && s=$(awk '/name: Build integration test container/{f=1; print; next} f && /^ *- name:/{exit} f' .github/workflows/ci.yml) && [ -n "$s" ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -q 'cache-from'

behavior: AC10 — P1.5 shipped or declined, with the critical-path measurement recorded
verification: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && v=$(git ls-files -- '*CI-004-testing-surface-optimization/verification.md' | head -1) && [ -n "$v" ] && grep -Eq 'AC10 .*P1\.5 (shipped|declined)' "$v" && grep -q 'p50 of 486 s' "$v"
